TRUMP'S DISCLOSED PORTFOLIO ADDS UP TO $3.8B, HERE'S WHAT'S ACTUALLY INSIDE EACH CATEGORY

Real estate & golf: $1.44B (37%)

- Includes 12 properties capped at "$50M+" each: Mar-a-Lago, Trump Tower, Bedminster, Doral, Turnberry, Seven Springs, Trump Park Ave, Trump Hotel Chicago, and more. Plus $235M in "other real estate."

Stocks: $744M (19%)

- $461M in unnamed "other stocks." Named positions include Apple ($38M), Nvidia ($35M), Alphabet ($32M), Broadcom ($27M), Microsoft ($26M), Amazon ($25M), Meta ($20M), and Tesla ($19M).

Bonds & notes: $714M (19%)

- $360M municipal, $288M corporate, $66M US government.

Crypto: $249M (6%)

- $115M in World Liberty Ethereum, $100M in World Liberty Bitcoin, plus smaller stablecoin holdings.

Operating businesses: $237M (6%)

- $172M unnamed "other," $50M in The Trump Corp, $15M in Trump Retail.

Cash & money market: $222M (6%)

- $122M other cash and bank, $100M money-market accounts.

ETFs & funds: $182M (5%)

- $104M in unnamed "other ETFs," plus named positions in SPY ($30M), VIG ($18M), SPHQ ($15M), and IGM ($15M). Truth Social sits in this bucket too, capped at the form's "$50M+" floor.

Shoutout to our partners over at Leverage Shares for making this graphic 🫡
